<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1029
Claimant:
Brandi Miller
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
13 Jul 2025
Reported today by the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney, following a rear-end collision at a city
intersection. The claimant reports neck and back discomfort and says they were the driver of the stopped vehicle that
was struck from behind.
31 Jul 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirms the collision happened as the claimant described and says they were
following too closely in slow traffic. Took the other driver's insurance details and their statement.
17 Sep 2025
Photos from the scene and the damage on both vehicles line up with the impact described by the claimant. Rear
bumper and trunk damage on the claimant's car is consistent with a rear-end impact at low speed.
19 Sep 2025
Requested the police report. The responding officer's notes say the claimant was not inside the vehicle when the
collision occurred, which differs from the account given to me so far. Will clarify this with the claimant.
2 Oct 2025
Called the claimant to ask about the discrepancy in the police notes. The claimant gave the same account of the
collision as in the first report and said the earlier note was likely mistaken, adding that they got out only after the other
car stopped.
5 Oct 2025
Two independent witnesses gave statements that match the other driver's version of the impact. Neither witness
could confirm where the claimant was seated at the moment of contact, so the question remains open.
25 Oct 2025
Checked the claimant's vehicle history. No prior damage to the rear of the car is recorded, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the policy's effective coverage period. The driver is named on the policy.
3 Nov 2025
The claimant has been seen by a treating provider for a back strain. The injury is plausible for a collision of this type,
and the claimant reports no earlier injury to the same area. Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this
diagnosis, so I've asked for the treatment notes.
25 Dec 2025
Received the treatment notes and reviewed the medical timeline. Records show consistent complaints from the first
visit onward, and the claimant has described the symptoms the same way in every conversation. No prior records for
the same body region were found.
15 Feb 2026
Reviewed the full file with the supervisor. The impact, vehicle damage and the other driver's account all support the
reported collision. The open item is the officer's note on the claimant's position in the vehicle, which needs to be
resolved before a settlement offer is made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
